record.one_liner: Copper is a CRM for contacts, companies, opportunities, pipelines and activities, with a REST Developer API for building custom integrations.
record.auth_notes: API keys are generated by Admin users in the Copper web app (System settings > API Keys) and sent as headers along with the token owner's email. OAuth2.0 is offered but requires registering the app with Copper first, and Copper describes it as the preferred approach for partner integrations.
record.access_notes: critic: access self_serve_free -> self_serve_trial. Copper has no free plan (its own comparison page says it doesn't have a free plan), only a 14-day free trial with no credit card. Admin users can generate API keys in-app; no docs page found that restricts API keys to a specific plan tier. OAuth registration requires contacting Copper.
record.api_notes: Docs say the Dev API gives access to most Copper resources with read and write requests. Breadth is a judgement call based on that wording; object-level coverage was not checked endpoint by endpoint.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials and a documented REST API are self-serve within a 14-day trial (and on paid plans); no vendor review needed for API-key use. Plan-tier gating of API keys not documented. The official Copper MCP server is a beta launching November 2026 with a waitlist/early-access form, so it is not yet generally usable.
